entities.summary: Daniel Meagher is a Canadian basketball player and Olympian. Among his accomplishments, he played for Duke from 1981-85; represented Canada in the 1984 Olympics; was a FISU gold medalist; and was drafted by the Chicago Bulls in the 1985 NBA Draft.
